If you haven't got real-time Data Engineering experience
Here's how you can make your own project for FREE !

Here’s a step-by-step guide to take you from raw data to a Power BI dashboard-all with FREE cloud tools. No more excuses. 

If you want to stand out, build and share real work.

Here’s how you do it 👇

1️⃣ Source Data (Python + Public Datasets)

Objective: Ingest real-world data into your pipeline.

- Use Python (`requests` or `pandas`) to fetch open datasets (CSV/JSON)
- Good sources: datahub.io, Google Dataset Search, Kaggle
- Save data locally or push to Azure Data Lake Gen2 / DBFS

(example)
python
import pandas as pd
url = "https://lnkd.in/gc7rWW-K"
df = pd.read_csv(url)
df.to_csv("global_temp.csv", index=False)

2️⃣ Transform in Databricks (PySpark)

Objective: Clean and process data at scale using Spark.

- Upload your CSV to Databricks (Community Edition is FREE)
- Open a notebook, clean and join data with PySpark
- Save as Delta table or write to external storage

(example)
python
df = spark.read.csv("/FileStore/global_temp.csv", header=True, inferSchema=True)
df_cleaned = df.filter("Mean > 0").withColumnRenamed("Mean", "MeanTemperature")
df_cleaned.write.format("delta").save("/mnt/processed/global_temp")


3️⃣ Load to Online Data Warehouse

Objective: Store clean data for analytics/reporting.

- Set up Azure SQL Database (free tier)
- Use Databricks JDBC or pyodbc to load clean data

(example)
python
df_cleaned.write \
.format("jdbc") \
.option("url", "jdbc:sqlserver://.database.windows.net:1433;database=") \
.option("dbtable", "dbo.GlobalTemperature") \
.option("user", "") \
.option("password", "") \
.mode("overwrite") \
.save()

4️⃣ Build Dashboards in Power BI

Objective: Visualize data and derive insights.

- Open Power BI Desktop
- Connect to Azure SQL
- Create line charts, KPIs, slicers
- Publish to Power BI Service (optional)


Project Structure:
- /data → raw datasets (CSV/JSON)
- /sql → transformation logic
- /notebooks → Databricks notebooks
- /tests → validation scripts
- README.md → overview + setup


Key Skills You Practice:
• Python scripting
• PySpark transformations
• Databricks workflows
• Azure SQL integration
• Power BI reporting
• Cloud-native workflow


You can use other tools like ADF for ingestion, key-vault for better security and airflow for scheduling your pipeline.


💡 Add this project to your portfolio or use it in interviews. All tools are free or have generous tiers. No paid subscriptions.


Need help setting this up or want feedback on your repo? 
Connect 1:1 here ➡️ https://lnkd.in/gH4DeYb4
